rows.commentary: 5.6: Marco Jansen drifts a fuller delivery around off stump, which Tanzid Hasan Tamim punches firmly towards the wide mid-off fielder.
6.1: Kagiso Rabada charges in at 142.5 kph, angling a back-of-a-length ball into middle and leg that Najmul Hossain Shanto covers and clips toward short leg.
6.2: Kagiso Rabada hits 141.1 kph with a delivery that stays slightly low, prompting Najmul Hossain Shanto to nudge it cautiously into the mid-wicket region.
6.3: Kagiso Rabada offers width outside off, allowing Najmul Hossain Shanto to lean forward and cream an exquisite boundary through mid-off.
6.4: Kagiso Rabada tests the batsman with a delivery keeping low around middle and leg, which Najmul Hossain Shanto soft-hands to mid-on before scampering across for a single.
6.5: Kagiso Rabada pitches full outside off and Tanzid Hasan Tamim presents the full face of his bat for a textbook cover-driven boundary.
6.6: Kagiso Rabada rattles in at 144.4 kph with a fuller ball outside off, met by Tanzid Hasan Tamim with high elbows as he drives it straight to the wide mid-off fielder.
7.1: Paterson drifts one onto the pads, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim nudges it away into the mid-wicket region for a single.
7.2: Paterson lands a length delivery around middle and leg, which Tanzid Hasan Tamim nudges safely toward mid-wicket.

7.3: Paterson angles in a sharp wobble-seam delivery that nips past Tanzid Hasan Tamim's inside edge to rap him flush on the pad, but the umpire rightly dismisses the loud lbw appeal as it pitches comfortably outside leg.
7.4: Paterson serves a length delivery around middle and leg that catches an inside edge off Tanzid Hasan Tamim's bat and onto his pads.
7.5: Paterson angles a good-length ball away outside off, drawing a tentative poke from Tanzid Hasan Tamim that beats the outside edge entirely.
7.6: Dane Paterson spears the ball in full at one hundred and thirty decimal seven kilometers per hour, finding the inside edge of Tanzid Hasan Tamim to thud into the pads.
8.1: Kagiso Rabada targets the stumps, and Najmul Hossain Shanto simply clips it straight to the waiting hands at short leg.
8.2: Firing from round the wicket, Kagiso Rabada traps Najmul Hossain Shanto on the pads with a stifled appeal as replays confirm a thin inside edge on the flick.
8.3: Kagiso Rabada lands it back of a length outside the off stump, allowing Najmul Hossain Shanto to comfortably shoulder arms as the ball moves away.
8.4: Kagiso Rabada attacks the middle and leg channel on a length, catching Najmul Hossain Shanto right on the pads as he attempts a nudge.
8.5: Kagiso Rabada shatters the off stump with a fiery scrambled seam delivery that beats the drive of Najmul Hossain Shanto, sparking a roaring celebration.
18.2: Marco Jansen drops it slightly short outside off, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim gets right behind the line to block it safely beneath his gaze.
18.3: Marco Jansen persists with the shorter length outside off, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim watches it pass without offering a stroke.
18.4: Marco Jansen pitches it closer to the off stump where it rears sharply off a length, beating Tanzid Hasan Tamim on the defensive push.

18.5: Marco Jansen extracts extra bounce as Tanzid Hasan Tamim closes the bat-face early off the back foot, sending a leading edge airborne that clips Ackermann's fingertips on its way to deep point for a couple.
18.6: Marco Jansen induces yet another leading edge from Tanzid Hasan Tamim, though this one rolls harmlessly along the turf toward the off-side.
19.1: Wiaan Mulder finds late away-movement on a length outside off, drawing an edge from Towhid Hridoy that drops just short of third slip on its path to third man.
19.2: Wiaan Mulder delivers back of a length outside off, allowing Towhid Hridoy to cushion it softly past gully toward deep backward point for three runs as the fielder rescues it near the ropes.
19.3: Wiaan Mulder angles one back of a length across Tanzid Hasan Tamim, who stays back in his crease to steer a defensive push toward point.
19.4: Wiaan Mulder attacks the middle with a shortish delivery, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim tucks it neatly into the vacant square-leg region for a single.
19.5: Wiaan Mulder probes the off-stump channel with a teasing length delivery, but Towhid Hridoy wisely chooses to leave it alone.

19.6: Wiaan Mulder strays onto the pads, giving Towhid Hridoy the opportunity to clip it into the deep mid-wicket gap for a comfortable brace following their aggressive recovery after three early blows.
20.1: Marco Jansen bangs it in short at the stumps, forcing Tanzid Hasan Tamim to sway away from the line of fire.
20.2: Marco Jansen digs it in short at the mid-riff, extracting extra bounce to strike Tanzid Hasan Tamim high as he camps back.
20.3: Marco Jansen offers a length delivery outside off that moves away, allowing Tanzid Hasan Tamim to leave it alone.
20.4: Marco Jansen serves up width outside off on the back of a length, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim pounces in a flash to cut it away to deep backward point for four.
20.5: Marco Jansen pushes it full on off with a hint of outward movement, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim gets right behind the line to block.
20.6: Marco Jansen digs it slightly shorter, catching the air off Tanzid Hasan Tamim's bat before dropping safely short of the point fielder.
21.1: Wiaan Mulder strays onto the pads, letting Towhid Hridoy tuck it into the gap at backward square leg for a single despite the call for two.
21.2: Wiaan Mulder delivers back of a length outside off with a bit of inward shape, prompting Tanzid Hasan Tamim to leave it.
21.3: Mulder hits the back of a length outside off, drawing a watchful, back-foot defense from Tanzid Hasan Tamim that trickles away softly towards the bowler's right.
23.5: Simon Harmer tosses it up with inward turn, allowing Towhid Hridoy to tap it easily toward long-on for a single.
23.6: Simon Harmer concludes a tidy opening over as Tanzid Hasan Tamim strides forward to deadbat the floated delivery on off stump.
24.1: Paterson angles one in from a length, prompting Towhid Hridoy to step forward and absorb the delivery into his defensive stance.
24.2: Paterson probes a tighter line around off, and Hridoy gets forward to drop it solidly onto the pitch.
24.3: Paterson attacks the off stump on a length, with Hridoy positioning himself right behind the line to block it.
24.4: Paterson probes full outside off, and Towhid Hridoy steps firmly forward to smother it into the covers.
24.5: Paterson fires a full one into the stumps, and Hridoy shifts across to steer it toward short mid-wicket.
24.6: Paterson drifts onto the pads, allowing Hridoy to clip the ball smoothly away toward square leg.
25.1: Simon Harmer drops it flatter outside off, and Tamim reaches out to punch his cut shot straight to point.
25.2: Simon Harmer tosses one up on middle, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim slog sweeps it into the deep square leg region to celebrate a magnificent fifty amid roaring applause from the dressing room.
25.3: Simon Harmer floats it up outside off, and Tamim keeps it down safely on the off side.
25.4: Simon Harmer extracts sharp drift into the left-hander, forcing Tamim to block the ball firmly to the right of the bowler.
25.5: Simon Harmer drifts it full into middle, and Tanzid Hasan Tamim drops to one knee to sweep it safely away toward backward square leg for a single just moments before the interval.
25.6: Simon Harmer loops up a final delivery before the break, and Towhid Hridoy defends solidly onto the pitch to signal the end of the opening session.
26.1: Kagiso Rabada opens the afternoon session spraying a loosener sharply down the leg side, leaving Tanzid Hasan Tamim completely flummoxed as he attempts a flick.
26.2: Kagiso Rabada charges in from round the wicket, extracting vicious inward movement from a back-of-a-length delivery that sneaks past Tanzid Hasan Tamim's inside edge.
26.3: Kagiso Rabada attacks the channel on a length, sharp seam movement catching the edge as Tanzid Hasan Tamim guides it aerially over point for four.
35.6: Paterson finds a good length outside off, and Towhid Hridoy solidly gets behind the line to block.
36.1: Marco Jansen hits a good length outside off with extra bounce as Litton Das watches it through to safety.
36.2: Marco Jansen targets a length around off, which Litton Das checks into the off-side.
36.3: Marco Jansen comes round the wicket and whirs past Litton Das's outside edge, prompting a quick glance back at the keeper.
36.4: Marco Jansen pitches it up outside off, allowing Litton Das to ignore it safely.
36.5: Marco Jansen strays short down leg, and Litton Das swivels to pull it away with authority to the fine leg boundary.
36.6: Marco Jansen lands one on a length around off, dead-batted straight down the surface by Litton Das.
37.1: Wiaan Mulder drops it into the pads, allowing Towhid Hridoy to clip a single through square leg.
37.2: Wiaan Mulder induces a front-foot push from Litton Das straight toward mid-on.
37.3: Wiaan Mulder offers a full delivery around off, driven cleanly to the cover fielder.
37.4: Wiaan Mulder shortens his length slightly as Litton Das rises with the bounce to steer it toward cover.
37.5: Wiaan Mulder angles a length ball into middle and leg, softly nudged by Litton Das toward mid-wicket.
37.6: Wiaan Mulder delivers a fuller length on middle and leg, safely patted back toward mid-on by Litton Das.
38.1: Marco Jansen comes from round the wicket, pinning Towhid Hridoy back inside his crease for a stock defensive block.
38.2: Jansen pitches it up outside off, allowing Hridoy to angle the face and guide it toward backward point.
38.3: Hridoy cushions the ball gently toward mid-on, scampering across to sneak a sharp single.
38.4: Jansen operates on a length around middle and leg, met firmly by Litton Das as he drives it straight to mid-on.
38.5: Litton Das aggressively dismisses the short delivery, ripping a fierce pull shot past the desperate dive at deep square leg for four.
38.6: Jansen fires the final delivery of the over into the block-hole, concluding the session as players pause for drinks.
49.6: Simon Harmer floats it up to Litton Das, who shifts across and steers the ball straight into the hands of short mid-wicket.
50.1: Wiaan Mulder delivers a fuller length on off stump, prompting Towhid Hridoy to punch it toward mid-off.
50.2: Wiaan Mulder angles one in from outside off, allowing Hridoy to work it away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
50.3: Wiaan Mulder keeps it full and angling in, and Das solidly defends it in the direction of mid-on.
50.4: Wiaan Mulder goes back of a length outside off, and Das guides it toward deep backward point to collect a single.
50.5: Wiaan Mulder drops slightly shorter outside off, which Hridoy deftly guides down to deep backward point for one.
50.6: Wiaan Mulder fires it full on off stump, and Das keeps his bat straight to defend it firmly toward mid-off.
51.1: Simon Harmer is greeted by Hridoy charging down the wicket to take it on the full, flicking it into the gap at deep mid-wicket for a brace.
51.2: Simon Harmer drops it slightly shorter, prompting Hridoy to step back and cut it toward cover point for a comfortable single.
51.3: Simon Harmer drifts one full onto middle and leg, forcing Das to drop to one knee and scramble a sweep away to backward square leg.
51.4: Simon Harmer zips through a quicker, sharp-turning delivery that catches Hridoy high on the front pad as he prods forward.
51.5: Simon Harmer tosses up a slower delivery, inviting Hridoy forward into a watchful defensive stroke.
51.6: Simon Harmer floats it up, and Towhid Hridoy skips down the track to punch a single down to long-on.
52.1: Wiaan Mulder drops it back outside off, leaving Towhid Hridoy to stand tall and block it toward point.
52.2: Wiaan Mulder targets the pads with a full delivery, clipped away by Towhid Hridoy toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
52.3: Wiaan Mulder angles a full one inward, allowing Litton Das to work it smoothly into the mid-wicket region.
52.4: Wiaan Mulder pulls his length back outside off, checked securely into the covers by a back-footed Towhid Hridoy.
52.5: Wiaan Mulder keeps it full on off stump, nudged firmly toward mid-off by Towhid Hridoy.
52.6: Wiaan Mulder sends down a wide length ball that Towhid Hridoy watches past to Ryan Rickelton standing up at the stumps.
59.2: Paterson drops it in, and Towhid Hridoy simply nudges the ball away toward the on-side.
59.3: Paterson targets a length outside off, allowing Towhid Hridoy to steer it into the off-side for a single.
59.4: Paterson pitches it up invitingly, meeting the straight bat of Litton Das who pushes it securely toward mid-off.
59.5: Paterson fires it full and straight at the stumps, coaxing a rapid single to mid-on despite Jansen missing a wayward shy at the bowler's end.
59.6: Paterson extracts an inside edge off a good length around middle and leg, letting Towhid Hridoy scamper back for a couple of runs through the on-side.
60.1: Kagiso Rabada attacks the stumps with a checked drive from Litton Das toward mid-on.
60.2: Kagiso Rabada entices an outside edge past gully for four, sealing a hard-fought fifty as Litton Das raises his bat to the dressing room.
60.3: Kagiso Rabada drops one on a length outside off, leaving Litton Das an easy decision to watch it sail through to the keeper.
60.4: Kagiso Rabada serves up a fuller delivery on the stumps, easily flicked into the mid-wicket pocket by Litton Das for two comfortable runs.
60.5: Kagiso Rabada steams in at 137 clicks and goes full outside off, where Litton Das opens the face to squeeze it through the off-side.
60.6: Kagiso Rabada maintains a probing length around off, comfortably met by the firm defensive push of Towhid Hridoy towards cover.
61.1: Simon Harmer drops a shade short on middle and leg, prompting a soft leg-side nudge from Litton Das.
61.2: Simon Harmer tosses one up and Litton Das drops to one knee to sweep it away to the deep backward square leg boundary.
61.3: Simon Harmer finds an lbw appeal against Litton Das as he misses a sweep, but the impact is safely outside off stump.
61.4: Litton Das skips down the pitch to Simon Harmer and flicks the delivery away toward the deep mid-wicket fence.
61.5: Simon Harmer fires a flatter delivery onto leg stump, which Litton Das clips neatly into the leg-side.
61.6: Simon Harmer tosses this one up with inviting flight, allowing Towhid Hridoy to push a drive out to wide mid-off.
62.1: Marco Jansen steams in from round the wicket to send down a full length delivery to Towhid Hridoy.
71.6: Wiaan Mulder digs this one in short outside off, getting it to seam away as Towhid Hridoy steers it cleanly through the off-side for a single.
72.1: Simon Harmer tosses it up on off and Towhid Hridoy strokes it away toward mid-off to pick up a comfortable run.
72.2: Simon Harmer imparts sharp turn in from outside off as Litton Das plays it away toward short fine.
72.3: Simon Harmer flights this too full on middle, allowing Litton Das to work it down to deep mid-wicket for a single that brings up a rock-solid 150-run partnership.
72.4: Simon Harmer fires in a flatter delivery outside off and Towhid Hridoy gets behind it to defend safely into the off side.
72.5: Simon Harmer extracts extra turn with a flatter, shorter trajectory as Towhid Hridoy drops back to block it out.
72.6: Towhid Hridoy dances down the track to take it on the full, driving powerfully to extra cover where Bavuma makes a half-stop to concede a single.
73.1: Wiaan Mulder drops a length delivery outside off that shapes away, and Towhid Hridoy watches it carefully on its way to the keeper.
73.2: Wiaan Mulder pitches it up on off stump, prompting Towhid Hridoy to stride forward and dead-bat the ball.
73.3: Wiaan Mulder serves a wide delivery outside off that moves further away, leaving Towhid Hridoy to get forward and let it sail through.
73.4: Wiaan Mulder bangs it back of a length outside off and Towhid Hridoy pushes it firmly out to deep point for a single.
73.5: Wiaan Mulder probes on a fullish line just outside off, tempting the batter, but Litton Das is content to watch it pass.
73.6: Wiaan Mulder drops it on a good length outside off, drawing Litton Das into leaving the moving ball alone.
74.1: Simon Harmer slides a flatter delivery into middle, safely pushed straight back to the bowler by Towhid Hridoy.
74.2: Simon Harmer loops it up on off stump, inviting Towhid Hridoy to nudge it toward the covers.
74.3: Simon Harmer offers a fraction of width outside off, allowing Towhid Hridoy to edge closer to his century with a sharp cut square behind point.
74.4: Simon Harmer tosses it up on middle, where Towhid Hridoy dances down the track and inside-edges a flick away toward backward square leg.
74.5: Simon Harmer fires a full delivery into middle, neatly clipped away by Litton Das toward deep mid-wicket.
74.6: Simon Harmer flights a fuller ball onto the stumps, met firmly by Towhid Hridoy's forward defensive prod.

81.3: Marco Jansen pitches it full and shapes it into the pads, allowing Litton Das to clip it into the gap at deep square leg where the chasing fielder pulls it back just inside the ropes for a pair of runs.
81.4: Marco Jansen keeps it full around the off stump, prompting Litton Das to block it towards the covers before being firmly sent back by his partner when eyeing a quick single.

81.5: Marco Jansen attacks with a fullish delivery just outside leg stump as Litton Das shuffles across to the off side and misses his intended clip, watching the ball zip past uncomfortably close to the timber.
81.6: Marco Jansen extracts extra kick off the surface as Litton Das fishes outside off and is beaten all ends up, reaching for a delivery that ultimately bypasses his bat entirely.
82.1: Kagiso Rabada steams in from a length to cramp Towhid Hridoy outside off, but the batter gets right behind the line to solidly defend it back down the ground.
82.2: Kagiso Rabada drops one slightly shorter outside off with away movement, prompting Towhid Hridoy to gracefully lift his bat and let it sail through to the keeper.
82.3: Kagiso Rabada angles his delivery right into the stumps, allowing Towhid Hridoy to work it away effortlessly toward backward square leg for a couple of runs.
82.4: Kagiso Rabada serves up a full delivery tailing into the stumps, which Towhid Hridoy calmly defends straight down on the track.
82.5: Kagiso Rabada steams in once more from a length, and Towhid Hridoy plays a solid defensive stroke out toward the covers.
82.6: Kagiso Rabada attacks on a good length outside off with steep bounce, leaving Towhid Hridoy to comfortably shoulder arms as the ball moves away.
83.1: Marco Jansen fires it back of a length outside off and angling across, with Litton Das perfectly content to leave it alone on ninety-one with stumps looming.
83.2: Marco Jansen pitches full on off stump and angles it in, prompting Litton Das to stride forward and dead-bat the ball right back down the pitch.

83.3: Marco Jansen digs it in from a length and extracts extra bounce to catch Litton Das high on the thigh pad, prompting a half-hearted appeal that the umpire rightly dismisses as drifting down leg.
83.4: Marco Jansen extracts extravagant seam movement away from Litton Das, zipping past the outside edge with terrifying precision.
83.5: Marco Jansen drops slightly shorter and angles it into the batter, allowing Litton Das to work it cleanly toward backward square leg for a single.
83.6: Marco Jansen delivers a devastating low full-toss that traps Towhid Hridoy plumb in front, bringing a magnificent 137-run innings to a dramatic close on the final ball of the day.
91.1: Paterson strikes immediately on Day Two as Mehidy Hasan Miraz reaches lazily for a full delivery, steering an outside edge straight to Wiaan Mulder at first slip.
91.2: Paterson tests Hasan Mahmud with a fullish, angling delivery that draws the batsman forward into a solid defensive stance.
91.3: Paterson offers a tempting drivable length around off, but Hasan Mahmud ignores the bait and watches it sail through to the keeper.
91.4: Hasan Mahmud shifts across to cover the line, managing only an outside half on defense as the ball trickles toward point.
91.5: Paterson targets the channel outside off with a full delivery, yet Hasan Mahmud exercises complete discipline and leaves it alone.
91.6: Hasan Mahmud drives a straight, movement-free fullish ball through cover from the front foot, declining an invitation for a single from Litton.
92.1: Kagiso Rabada digs one short at the body, forcing Litton Das to swivel and pull toward deep square leg where he rejects the run.
92.2: Rabada extracts low bounce and away movement from an off-stump length, leaving Litton Das to watch it pass while the bowler checks the pitch.
92.3: Pulling his length back outside off, Rabada forces Litton Das to offer no stroke as the ball darts back inward.
92.4: Litton Das shuffles across and forward, calmly permitting another back of a length delivery outside off to drift harmlessly by.
92.5: Rabada's wobble seam cuts Litton Das entirely in half, slicing sharply between bat and pad as the batter flashes away from his body.
92.6: Clocked at 139.1kph, Rabada's fuller offering is crisply driven straight to mid-off without a run on offer.
93.1: Paterson lands a fullish delivery at 132.3kph straight into the stumps, met by a resolute front foot block from Hasan Mahmud.
93.2: Paterson offers width with a slightly short delivery outside off, and Hasan wisely lets it die harmlessly in front of the keeper.
93.3: Paterson induces utter hesitation from Hasan, who flinches a late pull and trickles a faint edge bouncing through to the slips.
93.4: Paterson fires in a sharp bouncer on the off side, easily ducked under by Hasan Mahmud.
93.5: Paterson tempts Hasan with width, drawing an edge that races away through the cordon to deep backward point for four.
100.4: Marco Jansen hunts in close, hustling Ebadot Hossain from a tight length as the batter gropes wildly off the back foot.
100.5: Round the wicket darts Marco Jansen, angling it back into Ebadot Hossain who is comprehensively beaten on the crease once again.
100.6: Marco Jansen targets the timber with a sharp lifter, leaving Ebadot Hossain completely stranded on defense.

101.1: Paterson bowls full to Taskin Ahmed, who clears room and swats it down the ground where Bavuma's despairing dive only deflects it onto the ropes for four, bringing up the four hundred for Bangladesh.

101.2: Paterson finds the edge of Taskin Ahmed's bat with a shortish ball outside off, and Wiaan Mulder snares the catch at third man to wrap up the innings with Paterson claiming all four wickets to fall today.
0.1: Taskin Ahmed starts on a pristine length outside off, extracting subtle away movement as Aiden Markram safely shoulders arms.
0.2: Taskin Ahmed delivers full and tailing into the stumps, met by a watchful defensive prod from Aiden Markram toward short mid-wicket.
0.3: Taskin Ahmed squares up Aiden Markram with a sharp inward seamer that takes the inside edge and thuds into the pads.
0.4: Taskin Ahmed hits a probing length angled in at the batter, smartly tucked away by Aiden Markram toward square-leg.
0.5: Taskin Ahmed extracts extra bounce from around off stump, inviting Aiden Markram to watch it sail through cleanly.
0.6: Taskin Ahmed hits a back-of-a-length line wide outside off, leaving Aiden Markram unbothered as it shapes further away.
1.1: Hasan Mahmud drifts onto the pads of MJ Ackerman, who turns it securely into the gap at mid-wicket to get off the mark.
1.2: Hasan Mahmud feeds the width, and Aiden Markram pounces, standing tall to slap a short delivery off the back foot through backward point for four.
1.3: Hasan Mahmud strikes immediately as a length ball straightens off the seam, drawing a tentative edge from Aiden Markram through to Litton Das.
2.3: Taskin Ahmed fires it full on middle, and MJ Ackerman shuffles across to push it firmly toward mid-on.
2.4: Taskin Ahmed tests the back of a length with an away angle, inducing a mistimed cut from MJ Ackerman straight to point.
2.5: Taskin Ahmed hits a precise length outside off with extra bounce, allowing MJ Ackerman to lift his bat and watch it sail through.
2.6: Taskin Ahmed outsmarts the charging MJ Ackerman with a venomous seam-away delivery that completely beats the batsman's outside edge.
3.1: Hasan Mahmud drops it slightly short outside off with away shape, leaving Zubayr Hamza entirely unperturbed as he lets it pass.
3.2: Hasan Mahmud pushes it wide outside off with subtle movement, prompting Zubayr Hamza to track it comfortably into the gloves.
3.3: Hasan Mahmud attacks from wide of the crease, angling it inward as Zubayr Hamza steps forward to dead-bat the delivery.
3.4: Hasan Mahmud drives it back from a menacing length, cramping Zubayr Hamza who dead-bats it into the pitch with minimal fuss.
3.5: Hasan Mahmud digs it in short of a length with a sharp inward jags, enabling Zubayr Hamza to punch it past backward point for his first boundary.
3.6: Hasan Mahmud snaps a venomous delivery into the stumps, and Zubayr Hamza anchors his weight to drop a defensive barrier.
4.1: Taskin Ahmed tests the channel outside off, extracting extra bounce and seam away as MJ Ackerman wisely lifts his bat to let it pass.
4.2: Taskin Ahmed finds the right spot with a full delivery angling in, but his front foot oversteps as Ackerman manages a faint edge.
4.2: Taskin Ahmed pushes fuller on off stump, allowing Ackerman to punch it cleanly into the gap at cover for a single.
4.3: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short outside off, forcing Zubayr Hamza to duck underneath the delivery.
4.4: Taskin Ahmed oversteps on a sharp delivery that nips back to beat Hamza's defense, brushing the pad on its way through.
4.4: Taskin Ahmed angles a full delivery into the pads, and Hamza collects a leg bye after failing to connect with the clip.
4.5: Taskin Ahmed pulls his length back slightly onto the stumps, and Ackerman works it away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
4.6: Taskin Ahmed attacks full on off stump, and Hamza drives firmly forward straight to the fielder at mid-off.
12.1: Ebadot Hossain targets the pads, allowing Zubayr Hamza to nudge it cleanly toward square leg.
12.2: Ebadot Hossain drops too short and straight, permitting Zubayr Hamza to glance it past mid-wicket and celebrate a fifty-run partnership with a comfortable brace.
12.3: Ebadot Hossain searches for swing with an angling delivery pushed toward mid-on, but the umpire halts proceedings for a front-foot no ball.
12.3: Ebadot Hossain digs it in short toward the body, and Zubayr Hamza softly deflects the ball in the direction of square leg.
12.4: Ebadot Hossain offers a full length outside the off stump, prompting Zubayr Hamza forward to drive it straight to wide mid-off.
12.5: Ebadot Hossain fires in a low-skidding short ball that Zubayr Hamza negotiates by dropping down to dead-bat it right of the bowler.
12.6: Ebadot Hossain finishes the over as Zubayr Hamza strides onto the front foot to push the ball straight back to the bowler.
13.1: Hasan Mahmud steams in at 131.9kph, watching Marques Ackerman ride the extra bounce to tap it toward cover.
13.2: Hasan Mahmud pitches it full outside the off stump, leaving Marques Ackerman untroubled as he watches it sail past.
13.3: Hasan Mahmud adjusts his length slightly closer to Marques Ackerman, yet the line remains wide enough for another easy leave.
13.4: Hasan Mahmud delivers at 131.8kph on a length that skids through the surface, inviting Marques Ackerman to punch it firmly toward point.
13.5: Hasan Mahmud gets the ball to shape away outside off, prompting Marques Ackerman to shift across before opting to let it pass.
13.6: Hasan Mahmud fires it in at 133.5kph, angling toward the batter as Marques Ackerman meets it solidly with the full face of the bat.
14.1: Ebadot Hossain hits a 137.1kph length delivery that tails in, prompting Zubayr Hamza to block it firmly off the front foot.
14.2: Ebadot Hossain attacks from wide of the crease, sliding one in low to catch Zubayr Hamza off guard before the crouching batsman jams his bat down to bunt it away safely.
14.3: Ebadot Hossain pushes one sliding down leg as Zubayr Hamza attempts the clip and ultimately lets it go.
14.4: Ebadot Hossain attacks the off stump at 141.4kph, and Hamza steps forward to neatly smother the ball.
14.5: Ebadot Hossain digs it in short toward the waist, allowing Hamza to work it toward mid-wicket and saunter across for a comfortable single.
14.6: Ebadot Hossain drops it shortish outside off, and Marques Ackerman crisply chops it through cover point to rotate the strike.
15.1: Hasan Mahmud takes a fierce drive straight back off Marques Ackerman's bat directly to the forehead, sparking immediate concern before he reassuringly gets back to his feet.
24.6: Taskin Ahmed curls one in from a length, meeting a resolute forward defense from MJ Ackerman.
25.1: Mehidy Hasan Miraz loops it up on off stump, patted securely into the off side by Zubayr Hamza.
25.2: Mehidy Hasan Miraz skids a flatter delivery through, blocked reliably from the crease by Zubayr Hamza.
